title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
DATA ENGINEERING LEAD

£90,000 - £110,000 + BONUS

LONDON (HYBRID)

Are you a hands-on Data Engineering leader looking to shape the future of a modern cloud data platform? This is an opportunity to join a market-leading international organisation undergoing a significant digital and data transformation.

THE COMPANY

Our client is a well established international business with a large global footprint and reputation. With significant investment being made into its technology and data capabilities, the organisation is embarking on a major transformation programme to modernise its data infrastructure, tooling, and ways of working.

THE ROLE

As Data Engineering Lead, you will report into the Head of Data and take ownership of the organisation's Data Engineering capability.

  • Leading the design, development, and deployment of scalable data pipelines and architectures.
  • Managing and mentoring a team of Data Engineers, promoting engineering best practice and collaboration.
  • Prioritising workloads and managing demand across multiple projects and stakeholders.
  • Establishing and maintaining governance, documentation, CI/CD processes, and engineering standards.
  • Supporting a large-scale cloud transformation programme and helping define the future data strategy.

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience leading and developing Data Engineering teams.
  • Strong SQL and database expertise, including performance optimisation.
  • Deep understanding of data warehousing and data modelling principles.
  • Experience with Snowflake.
  • Exposure to AI, Machine Learning, or Advanced Analytics environments.
  • Relevant cloud certifications.
  • Experience working in large, complex enterprise environments.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • £90,000 - £110,000 base salary
  • Up to 40% bonus
  • Pension contribution
  • Hybrid working
  • Private healthcare
  • Opportunity to lead a business critical transformation programme

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your CV to Ross McEwan through the Apply link for a confidential discussion regarding the opportunity.
